title: Refining a dimension_group replaces its timeframes list
rule: timeframes is not additive, so a refinement replaces the list and keeps the parameters it does not set.

citations.quote: in most cases a refinement will override the original settings of an object
It specifies one or more timeframes that should be generated by the dimension group.

rationale: timeframes is not on the documentation's list of additive parameters, so the refinement's value overrides the base value.
